column1: # Habits: rows starting with + are sentences the user typed earlier, whose
# character n-grams Sugu learns (D-079); the others are text before the
# caret, typed reading, and the expected conversion, in new sentences that
# share those habits. Written 2026-10-20.

+彼は足が速い。
+紅茶が熱いです。
+厚い本を読んでいます。
+社会のために努めています。
